title: slicesdir
description: slicesdir generates a directory containing orthogonal slices through a set of images.

flag_filelist.description: Filelist contains pairs of images (underlying and red-outline images)
flag_filelist.title: Pairs of Images Flag

outline_image.description: Use the specified image as the red-outline image on top of all images in the file list
outline_image.title: Red-outline Image

edge_threshold.description: Use specified threshold for edges. If >0, use this proportion of max-min; if <0, use the absolute value
edge_threshold.title: Edge Threshold

slice_option.description: Output every second axial slice instead of 9 ortho slices
slice_option.title: Second Axial Slice Option

filelist.description: List of image files to process
filelist.title: File List
